#   lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.

# entries the same way. Product and technology names (PhotoCraft, ArtCraft, OpenType, CMYK, Lab ...)
# stay in Latin letters; the trailing "…" of dialog commands is kept.
# Conventions: menus are nouns (Plik, Edycja, Obraz ...), commands are infinitives (Otwórz…,
